extras.real_size: atomic age dream car, approx. 4.4 x 1.9 x 1.45 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.66 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; friendly retro-futuristic 1950s concept-style car: teardrop body, glass bubble dome over a two-seat cockpit, one large centre tail fin, rocket-style tail lights, rear fender skirts, whitewall tyres; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); no radiation or atom symbols, no brand, no logo, no text, blank number plates

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
